about: The Forge encoder registry: every frozen base model a project or an autopilot target may train heads on. One table, read as a file by forge/encoders.py (and by any head-set adapter that pins encoders from it). key = what settings, projects and targets store; revision = the Hugging Face commit the HF cache must hold; hidden = embedding width; approx_gb = the largest embedding-worker peak measured on this machine (approx_gb_source says where), null when never measured.

encoders.name: Qwen3-4B (MLX 4-bit)
encoders.approx_gb_source: max latency.encoder_peak_bytes over eval reports on a 48 GB Apple Silicon Mac
encoders.note: 2560-d; heads train from scratch. The default for head sets that need the full width.
